name: The Origin
description: A mysterious violet world where the first spark of existence begins.
detail:
THE BEGINNING OF EVERYTHING

Somewhere in the vastness of space, The Origin stands as a symbol of creation. Its violet surface is shaped by ancient forces and surrounded by an atmosphere of cosmic light.

It represents beginnings, imagination, and the courage to take the first step into the unknown.

Every journey starts somewhere. This is yours.

CLASS: Primordial Planet
ELEMENT: Cosmic Energy

name: Blue Horizon
description: A distant blue world wrapped in atmosphere, oceans, and endless possibilities.
detail:
THE EDGE OF THE UNKNOWN

Blue Horizon is a world of blue light, deep oceans, and drifting clouds. Its atmosphere creates a calm glow across the surface, while distant storms move slowly through its skies.

It represents the unknown and the desire to see what exists beyond the horizon.

CLASS: Oceanic Planet
ELEMENT: Water & Atmosphere

name: Silent Moon
description: A quiet celestial body floating through darkness, holding ancient memories.
detail:
THE ART OF SILENCE

Far from the noise of distant galaxies, Silent Moon moves quietly through the darkness. Its surface is covered with ancient terrain, dust, and countless craters formed over time.

It represents reflection, patience, and the beauty of quiet moments.

CLASS: Lunar Body
ELEMENT: Ancient Dust

name: Void
description: A mysterious region beyond the light, where imagination takes over.
detail:
BETWEEN LIGHT AND DARKNESS

Void is a place where the stars seem distant and the boundaries of reality feel uncertain. It represents the space between what is known and what has yet to be discovered.

The unknown is not simply an absence of answers. It is an invitation to ask better questions.

CLASS: Deep Space World
ELEMENT: Dark Matter

name: Eclipse
description: A world of contrast where light and shadow create a celestial spectacle.
detail:
THE MOMENT OF CHANGE

Eclipse is a world shaped by contrast. Its glowing horizon and deep shadows transform the landscape into a mysterious environment.

It represents change, transformation, and the ability to see the world from a different perspective.

CLASS: Celestial World
ELEMENT: Solar Light

name: Infinity
description: A world without borders, representing endless possibilities and exploration.
detail:
THE JOURNEY NEVER ENDS

Infinity is the final world in this collection, but it is not the end of exploration. Its glowing emerald atmosphere represents growth, imagination, and limitless possibilities.

There will always be new worlds, new ideas, and new things to understand.

CLASS: Infinite Dimension
ELEMENT: Possibility
